## How to cite

Until a citable release is published, please cite the tool as:

> Eulaers, I. (2026). *ACTAME: Arctic Conservation Tool for Area-based Measures
> and Ecosystems* (version 0.1.0) [Software]. Norwegian Polar Institute, for the
> joint PAME/CAFF project. <https://github.com/igoreulaers/PAME_MPA_EG_map>

Individual spatial layers should be cited to their original sources, which are
recorded per layer in the Atlas and Metadata components of the dashboard.
